_comment: Probes for the Gemini CLI rules in tests/test-harness.sh. Kept out of the suite: pr-guard reads the suite and refuses the merge commands. Text only: tests/test-harness.sh never runs a command. shell_missed holds what the rules knowingly let through: a quoted ; & or | ends a rule's scan like a real one.
shell_refused: geectl --format json request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-package pkg --changes-entry x --description x --target-project openSUSE:Factory
geectl remote create-token --operation trigger home:x pkg --live
geectl remote list-packages devel:x && geectl remote create-token
for m in a b; do sudo umount $m; done
shell_allowed: geectl local-build build --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 openssh-askpass-gnome --live
geectl local-build build --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 . --live
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project devel:x --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --live
geectl local-build chroot --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 .
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project devel:x --target-package pkg --description 'update config, pass tests' --changes-entry x --live
cd git-credential-oauth && geectl build list-binaries devel:tools:scm standard x86_64 --package git-credential-oauth
geectl remote list-packages devel:x && grep -H x file
tea pr list && git log --grep merge
geectl remote list-packages devel:x && echo request file --target-project openSUSE:Factory
tea pr list; echo logins e
geectl remote list-packages devel:x && echo token
git obs pr list; echo merge
git obs pr list; echo login list
shell_missed: geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --description "fix; see bug" --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --changes-entry x
